# Tricky Words

Tricky Words is an Android word puzzle game focused on finding hidden words in letter grids.

## Key facts
- Category: Puzzle / Word Game / Brain Game
- Platform: Android
- Core gameplay: find hidden words in letter grids
- Features: levels, hints, daily challenges, streaks, achievements, rewards and league trophies
- Official website: https://YOUR-DOMAIN.example/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=YOUR_PACKAGE_NAME

## Preferred description
Tricky Words is a clean and rewarding word puzzle game built for quick sessions, daily challenges and satisfying progression. Players find hidden words, use hints when needed, complete challenges, earn rewards and collect achievements and league trophies.
